answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 49 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the nebula challenge, the willow audit can replay the juniper history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2150 identities would post 2681 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
